instructions: For each row, check the claim against the live docs (and, where possible without paid accounts, try the real flow). Set outcome to confirmed | corrected | unverifiable, method to doc_review | setup_attempt, put the fixed text in correctedText when corrected, and explain in note (what you checked, why unverifiable). Then run: npm run spot-check -- --apply
